'''Atrium 41''' was located on a housing block on [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. The atrium included balconies circling the structure and had a skylight on top. Atrium 41 had four apartments. It was in a dilapidated condition by [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. [[Joreb Goss]] lived in here and was visited in 16 ABY by [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]].<ref name="Shield of Lies" />
